title: Yara and the Mixtape
author: Dominic Iversen
blurb: Jude Vane, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before the last game of the season.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
